transcript.text: We offer a free 30-minute consultation with one of our trained aesthetic practitioners to discuss your goals and recommend a treatment plan.
Yes, our consultations are completely free of charge. We believe it's a great way to discuss your goals and determine the best treatment plan for you.
Great, I'd like to book one. I'm free Saturdays.

Our clinic is open on Saturdays from 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM. You can book a consultation via our website at www.bloomaesthetics.com or through WhatsApp. Which method do you prefer to book your appointment?

summary.customer_intent: The customer inquired about consultations and booked a free consultation for a Saturday.
summary.recommended_next_action: Book free consultation via website or WhatsApp
summary.notes: Customer prefers Saturdays, clinic hours on Saturdays are 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM.
